method: Unmodified original EntityRemovalSystem, Iceberg, Presence, Visibility, allocator and bundled THREE in Chromium; canonical ?module imports. Plain Object3D actors have explicit local positions/presence/visibility. Clock/ticks/map existence/ring count/window size and requests are explicit inputs. Iceberg pools start empty per case; actual original reuse/retained transform state is exercised within cases. Snapshots cover queues, LIFO allocation, guards, first exit time, local reparenting, constant drift, stored bob/rotation/opacity, strict bounds, null-map early return, teleport thresholds and teardown/reuse. This does not certify actor/model/material pooling, concrete game-system registration, LOD/loading, input/audio or complete scene restart.
